full_text: The Sangguniang Kabataan secretary shall : (a) Keep all records of the katipunan ng kabataan and Sangguniang Kabataan; (b) Prepare and keep the minutes of all meetings of the katipunan ng kabataan and Sangguniang Kabataan; (c) Prepare all forms necessary for the conduct of registrations, elections, initiatives, referenda, or plebiscites, in coordination with the Barangay secretary and the Comelec; and (d) Perform such other duties and discharge such other functions as the chairman of the Sangguniang Kabataan may prescribe or direct.
